apps.reason: The first commit of apps#16; its later commits are in i085 (hooks) and i087 (test fixes).
apps.message:
ci: the change scope gates the catalog's site jobs

## Intent

Every change to the catalog ran all tests, the build and the deploy. With the change scope in the tooling, a plan-only change should run nothing and a docs-only change only the site.

## Key changes

- Pages and preview ask the tooling's reusable scope workflow first: only the plan runs nothing, only docs runs the site's build, check and deployment, anything else runs everything.
- The jobs site and preview always run and report, so the required checks keep their names and never stay pending; the listing workflow keeps its own paths filter.
- The pin of the tooling moves to the commit whose classifier the workflows run.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Same intent: lernapps/docs and lernapps.github.io gate their site jobs the same way; app-templates gets root hooks and gated CI.

app-templates.message:
feat(hooks): root git hooks and CI, gated by the change scope

## Intent

app-templates had no git hooks, so a formatting error of step 3 was first caught in CI, and every push ran every check. A plan-only or docs-only push should check nothing, and a push should check only the templates it touches.

## Key changes

- npm ci installs the repo's own hooks. Pre-commit formats and lints the staged files, quietly.
- Pre-push asks the tooling's classifier first, so a plan-only or docs-only push checks nothing; otherwise it runs the root checks and lernapps check only in the template folders the push affects, by an explicit path list. The fixture jobs stay in CI.
- The hook fetches only the classifier from the tooling at a pinned commit into .git/lernapps/ and runs it with Node: 1.7 s the first time, 0.3 s after. A devDependency made every app's install fetch and build the tooling once more; npx fails on npm 10 and is slow.
- A test checks that the hook's tooling commit is the one CI uses.
- CI gates every job on the scope, keeps the job names, adds actionlint, and has one final job check, the one to require.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Same intent: lernapps/apps, lernapps/docs and lernapps.github.io gate their site jobs with the same classifier.
